## Library Clusters {#topic-library-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Open Here</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Remote Sensing</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Sensor physics, retrieval logic, orbit geometry, and specialist observation systems live here as one coherent branch.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Or Here</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Cryosphere and Mountains</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Snow, glaciers, permafrost, and alpine hazards form a field-focused branch with strong internal identity.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Methods Branch</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Machine Learning</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Regression, dimensionality reduction, and quantitative depth appear here when readers are ready for later-stage methods.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Deep Cuts</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Environmental and Economic Extensions</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Biogeochemical depth, severe-weather chapters, and larger infrastructure systems round out the branch library.</div>
  </article>
</div>
```
